title: Gene Transfection toward Spheroid Cells on Micropatterned Culture Plates for Genetically-modified Cell Transplantation
protocol: Anesthetize Sprague Dawley (SD) rats under inhalation anesthesia with isoflurane.
Place the anesthetized rat on an operating table and ventilate using a mask.
Perfuse the livers of SD rats from the hepatic portal vein with a special solution containing specified components.
Circulate collagenase solution through the liver.
Remove the liver carefully.
Mince the liver gently on a dish using a scalpel blade.
Add Dulbecco’s Modified Eagle’s Medium (DMEM) supplemented with 10% fetal bovine serum (FBS).
Filter the cell suspension through a 100 μm nylon mesh.
Centrifuge the cell suspension at 20 × g for 1 min.
Repeat the centrifugation step twice more.
Centrifuge the hepatocytes at 50 × g for 3 min to recover them as a pellet.
Resuspend the hepatocytes to a concentration of 4 × 10^5 cells/ml in special culture medium.
Maintain hepatocytes in a medium composed of DMEM supplemented with components listed previously, mandatory for preserving hepatic function under in vitro conditions.
Euthanize Sprague Dawley (SD) rats by excessive administration of isoflurane.
Resect the femurs and tibias from euthanized SD rats.
Collect bone marrow cells using a 22 G needle flushed with DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS.
Filter collected cell suspension through a 100 μm nylon mesh.
Seed the cells onto 10 cm culture dishes using DMEM containing 10% FBS and 1% penicillin/streptomycin.
Obtain micropatterned culture plates with cell adhesive areas at 100 µm diameter surrounded by non-adhesive PEG matrix areas.
Coat the plates with thermosensitive polymer PIPAAm for cell detachment during transplantation.
Seed hepatocytes or MSCs on 12-well micropatterned plates at a density of 4 × 10^5 cells/well.
Incubate the seeded cells at 37 °C in a humidified atmosphere containing 5% CO2.
Cells will form round spheroids on the micropatterned adhesion areas within 2 days.
Synthesize a block copolymer PEG-PAsp(DET).
Synthesize a homopolymer composed of only the cationic segment PAsp(DET).
Prepare a mixed solution of PEG-PAsp(DET) and PAsp(DET) at an equal molar ratio of residual amino groups.
Adjust the polymer concentration to 33.3 µg/ml for the block copolymer in 10 mM HEPES buffer (pH 7.3).
Adjust the polymer concentration to 19.1 µg/ml for the homopolymer in 10 mM HEPES buffer (pH 7.3).
Clone the segment expressing the respective genes into the pCAG-GS plasmid using a commercial kit according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Amplify the pDNA in a competent Escherichia coli strain.
Purify the amplified pDNA using an endotoxin-free plasmid DNA purification system.
Determine the pDNA concentration at an absorbance of 260 nm to obtain a 150 μg/ml solution in 10 mM HEPES buffer (pH 7.3).
Thoroughly mix the pDNA solution with the premixed solution of two polymers at a ratio of 2:1 by volume to prepare polyplex nanomicelles.
Incubate the cells (hepatocytes or MSCs) for 72 hours after seeding onto micropatterned plates.
Replace the culture medium with 1 ml of fresh medium in each well for gene transfection.
Add 100 µl of polyplex nanomicelle solution containing 10 µg of pDNA to each well.
Continue incubation with the nanomicelle solution for 24 hours.
Mix pDNA solutions with a lipid-based transfection reagent at a weight ratio of 3:1 (reagent/pDNA).
Adjust the final dose of pDNA to be equal for both methods.
Replace the culture medium with 200 µl of chilled PBS and place the plates on ice.
Gently aspirate the cells in the suspension using a syringe with a 23 G or 27 G needle.
Collect 50 – 100 µl of the medium exactly 24 hours after replacing the culture medium.
Estimate the luciferase expression using a commercial renilla luciferase assay system.
Replace the medium with fresh one prior to collecting the sample medium for evaluating real-time efficiency of transgene expression.
Anesthetize BALB/c nude mice (female; 7 weeks old) under inhalation anesthesia with isoflurane.
Place a mouse in a chamber connected to an anesthesia machine providing isoflurane.
Take out the mouse after falling asleep, and set it on the operating table with ventilation using a mask.
Control the isoflurane flow approximately at 0.2 – 0.5 L/min by checking the conditions of the mouse.
Inject 200 μl of cell suspension containing spheroids transfected with the GL4 luciferase-expressing pDNA into the subcutaneous tissue of the abdominal region.
Immediately after injecting D-luciferin (150 mg/kg; intravenous route), measure the luciferase expression using IVIS imaging system according to manufacturer’s protocol.
Inject 200 μl of cell suspension containing spheroids transfected with the erythropoietin-encoding pDNA into the subcutaneous tissue of the abdominal region.
Collect blood samples by submandibular bleeding to obtain approximately 200 μl of blood.
Measure hemoglobin using a blood sample analyzer.
Measure hematocrit using a blood sample analyzer.
Place mice on a heating pad connected with a temperature controller until awakening from anesthesia.
